test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six bowlers B1, B2, B3, B4, B5 and B6 are compared on the basis of their bowling speed. Speed of B5 is more than B4 only. Speed of B1 is less than B2 and B3 more than B5 and B6.

Which of the following can be the correct order of their speed?
solution:
**Given: **Six bowlers B1, B2, B3, B4, B5 and B6 are compared on the basis of their bowling speed. 

1) Speed of B5 is more than B4 only. 

_ > _ > _ > _ > B5 > B4

2) Speed of B1 is less than B2 and B3 more than B5 and B6.

B2 > B3 > B1 > B6 > B5 > B4

Hence, **"Option 4" **is the correct answer.
